findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jp_business_card_extract · Private data: jp_invoice_extract, jp_business_card_extract · Public sink: jp_business_card_extract · Destructive: jp_invoice_extract, jp_receipt_extract.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jp_business_card_extract · Private data: jp_invoice_extract, jp_business_card_extract · Public sink: jp_business_card_extract · Destructive: jp_invoice_extract, jp_receipt_extract

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
